items.name: React

license.scope: MIT for the upstream library code; verify the license of the exact version you install.

items.summary: Component-based UI library for building interactive web interfaces.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-writing DOM diffing, component lifecycles and UI state wiring for interactive apps.
cautions: Pair with a framework (Next.js, React Router) for routing, data loading and SSR rather than assembling it yourself.
Server Components require a supporting framework and bundler.
install: Install with the project package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: Next.js

license.scope: MIT for the upstream library code; verify the license of the exact version you install.

items.summary: React framework with file-based routing, server rendering, Server Components and API routes.
items.useWhen: Use instead of hand-assembling React SSR, routing, code splitting and bundler configuration.
cautions: App Router and Pages Router differ; follow the docs for the router the project uses.
Some features (ISR, image optimization, middleware) behave differently when self-hosted versus on Vercel.
install: Install with the project package manager and commit the lockfile; pin the reviewed version.

items.name: FormatJS

license.scope: MIT for the upstream library code; verify the license of the exact version you install.
